colreg_complex.boundary: V2 deterministic complex-scenario regression layered over the preserved V1 oracle. It is not legal advice, an official local-rule service, flag/class acceptance or COLREG certification.

hil.boundary: UDP/NMEA codec, logical-time loopback, watchdog and fault-injection evidence only; no physical controller, actuator, bridge bus or class-witnessed HIL was connected.

sea_trial.boundary: Software checks declared completeness, raw-log integrity and metrics only. It cannot authenticate a vessel, permit, person, witness, signature or calibration record, so it never declares the sea trial completed.

boundary: PASS means the software verification and anti-overclaim gates executed successfully. Complex COLREG scenarios use an authored local-rule template; PASS does not mean official local rules, vessel calibration, COLREG certification, physical HIL, sea trial or production authorization.
